name: KartPad
subtitle: Mario Kart Wii on iOS
description: KartPad is a native Mario Kart Wii and Retro Rewind application for iPhone and iPad. It provides an iOS-focused interface for playing supported Mario Kart Wii content. KartPad does not include game images or copyrighted game data. Users are required to provide their own legally obtained files. KartPad is intended solely for legitimate emulation and preservation purposes.
